info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Listing Rule Preview API
info.description:
API for Coveo Platform

Contact Support:
 Name: Coveo

item.name: Preview the Impact of a Listing Rule.

query.description: (Required) The URL used to retrieve the products listings.
(Required) The name of the listing configuration.
(Required) The unique identifier of the listing configuration.
(Required) The unique identifier of the tracking target.
(Required) An ISO 639-1 language code.
(Required) An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
(Required) An ISO 4217 currency code.
The page of products to request.
The number of products per page. Note that a value greater than 100 may be rejected in the future.
Whether the rule is for the global config.
Whether to include the execution report on a successful response.

variable.description:
(Required) The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `acmecorporation8tp8wu3`
(Required) The unique identifier of the rule.

request.description:
Returns a preview of products.

**Required privilege:** Execute Query

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"SEARCH_API","targetDomain":"EXECUTE_QUERY","targetId":"*"} ```

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2
